purpose: Reviewed allowlist of every line by which the composed production Firestore Rules on gameplay/recovery-v1 differ from what production main deploys. The main gate must see exactly these changes and nothing else. Regenerate only with node tests/support/composed-production-rules.cjs --print-main-delta origin/main, then review every hunk.

hunks.why: r87 roulette marks: the existing Transfer Challenge create checks the new document's phase first (it already had to be WINDOW_OPEN), so a pre-window mark create never evaluates the ledger shape and its setup/career lookups. Same allowed set as before.

added: // Codex R87-E-01: a season's window opens only after the previous season was committed and acknowledged by both
// phones, so a wrong season number from a buggy caller can never create a future season. One lookup per START
// (seasons 2 to 10), never on later ledger writes or listener deliveries.
// R87 roulette marks: a pre-window mark document (phase NOT_STARTED) is never a ledger to update (START from it is
// ssjrTransferStartAfterSpins). The phase is tested before the ledger function's let bindings run: measured on the emulator,
// START from a two-mark document was refused while those bindings ran against it.
hunks.why: R87-E-01 previous-season ACKNOWLEDGED check on START, followed by the unchanged R87-SPINS phase-first ssjrTransferValidUpdate (the two edits are adjacent, so the diff joins them).
r87 roulette marks: the unchanged ledger update function under a new name, called only by ssjrTransferValidUpdate after its pre-window phase check (previous hunk). Body byte-identical.

hunks.why: Codex R87-E-04: the private signing lock uses the actor authority (account, device, ACTIVE session) so three r87 signing rows fit the 1,000-expression limit; the linked public ledger write in the same transaction still runs the full pair envelope.

added: // R87 roulette marks (Nik 2026-10-31, red team RT5-FLOW-02): the shared window waits until both managers have spun this season's
// Russian Roster Roulette. Before the window opens, transferChallenges/season_N may hold a small pre-window document whose
// spins map has a true entry per manager who has spun. Each member writes only his own entry (one merge write, one lookup: the
// rivalry, like the reads meter), never removes or changes the partner's, never removes his own, and never once the ledger has
// started. START from that document needs both entries and writes the normal ledger in its place (exact keys as before).
// A season with no marks (a Showdown from before the roulette) still starts by the create rule. Every branch first tests the
// phase of the stored or new document, so a normal ledger write never evaluates these and looks up nothing more.
// F2-02 (Fable job 2): a mark may record its manager's outcome for the season instead of plain true: fired, the shot player's
// name (as a signing name: 1-80 characters, trimmed), shirt number (0-99 or null), board slot 0-14 and the season he was
// signed (1-10, or null for a club player: the two are different people), and the engine and data version. A safe spin has
// no name, number, slot or season. Exact keys; nothing else.
|| (value.fired == false && value.hitName == null && value.hitNumber == null && value.hitSlot == null && value.hitSignedSeason == null)
// F2-02 (Fable job 2): START replaces the mark document with the ledger, so it also writes one durable record of both marks:
// transferChallenges/season_N/roulette/spins, an exact copy of the stored spins (both present, so final: each entry is written
// once). Created once, never updated, listed or deleted; members read it to replay earlier seasons' saved shots. One lookup
// more than START itself (the mark document as it stands before this request).
hunks.why: r87 roulette marks (Nik 2026-10-31 09:27 UTC, red team RT5-FLOW-02: the shared transfer window waits until both managers have spun the Russian Roster Roulette). Functions only: the pre-window document transferChallenges/season_N may hold a spins map with one true entry per manager who has spun; a member writes only his own entry (one lookup, the rivalry), never removes or changes the partner's or his own, and only while phase is NOT_STARTED; START from it needs both entries and writes the unchanged ledger in its place. No new path or read. Fable job 2 F2-02 (R87-HITS): a mark may carry its manager's outcome (fired, hitName, hitNumber, hitSlot 0-14, hitSignedSeason 1-10 or null for a club player per #1107, version; exact keys, ssjrTransferSpinOutcomeValid), each manager's entry is written once (!(role in before.spins)), START accepts outcome entries (!= false), and the record-create validator.
r87 Prime Pack: the result shape allows the sparse primePack key (Season Results and Season Commit), as r80 did for europaLeague.

added: // r87 Prime Pack (Nik 2026-10-31/11-01; feature spec project-documents/r88-icon-guess): once a season, before the transfer
// window, both phones reveal one masked card in four stages and each manager has two guesses. The round record is
// rivalries/{rid}/primePackRounds/season_N. Each manager writes only his own facts: his arrival (the server time, once),
// which he withdraws again only while the other manager has not arrived (he left the screen: ssjrPackLeave), then one
// guess at a time (his own chip count +1, at most 2, and namedBy set to himself when right), only while the round
// runs: the stages start 3 s after the later arrival and their guess timers are 25/20/20/20 s, each after a 1.5 s
// reveal (js/iconGuess.js), so guesses count from 2 s to 97 s after the later arrival (1 s and 2 s of network slack).
// Whether a guess is right is decided on the guessing phone (the answer is not stored, so it is never readable early);
// the Rules bind the order: namedBy is set once, never changed, the other manager's facts never touched, and the record's
// updatedAt is the winning write's server time (no write is allowed after it). A season result may carry primePack:N only
// for the manager this record names, with N the points of the stage that server time falls in: 4 before 30.5 s after the
// later arrival, 3 before 52 s, 2 before 73.5 s, then 1 (ssjrPackPoints). Changing the guess window means changing these.
return request.time >= (a > b ? a : b) + duration.value(2, 's')
&& (ssjrPackArrive(before, after, role) || ssjrPackLeave(before, after, role) || ssjrPackGuess(before, after, role));
return at < (a > b ? a : b) + duration.value(30500, 'ms') ? 4

Pure functions used only by the primePackRounds match and the private-result line below. A manager may withdraw his own arrival only while the other has not arrived (ssjrPackLeave, Fable F12-02).
r87 Prime Pack: the result shape allows the sparse primePack key (Season Results and Season Commit), as r80 did for europaLeague.

added: // R87 shared reads meter (B2): each phone keeps ONE small document per rivalry, rivalries/{rid}/meters/{its role}, with the
// Firebase reads it was billed today (documents + Rules lookups), written once a season when it sees the season commit
// ACKNOWLEDGED; the partner phone reads it once, so both phones show the same "both phones" total and seasons left.
// Members of the live paired rivalry only (one lookup: the rivalry, the same as every shared read), each phone writes only
// its own role's document, exact keys, bounded whole numbers (at most three season costs), no list and no delete.
// A phone on an older build never writes it; nothing else reads it.
function ssjrMeterCount(value, max) { return value is int && value >= 0 && value <= max; }
function ssjrMeterCost(costs, index) { return costs.size() <= index || (costs[index] is int && costs[index] > 0 && costs[index] <= 100000); }
hunks.why: r87 shared reads meter (B2, recommended on Nik's decision card 2026-10-31; not deployed): the validator for rivalries/{rid}/meters/{role}. Members of the live paired rivalry only (ssjrEntitled, one lookup: the rivalry), only the signed-in manager's own role, exact keys, schemaVersion 1, day YYYY-MM-DD, season 1-10, whole-number game and career counts up to 1,000,000, at most three season costs up to 100,000, updatedAt == request.time. No other path changes.
